purpose: Unjudged authored natural-language requests. Freeze before human judgments and any ranking changes. No concept IDs are supplied to systems.

queries.text: Find pairs in a sorted list without trying every possible pair.
Track how many letters occur in a moving substring.
Count routes when smaller results can be reused.
Explore connected cells in a grid.
Combine overlapping meeting times.
Search an ordered array by repeatedly halving the candidates.
Find the shortest contiguous text containing all required letters.
Choose the next available course after all its dependencies are done.
Find how much trapped water lies between columns.
Repeatedly remove the cheapest item while more items arrive.
Enumerate combinations and undo each choice before exploring another.
Keep connectivity information while merging groups.
Answer sums over many array ranges efficiently.
Find the next warmer day without scanning all later days for each day.
Look up words that share a prefix.
Update array elements and answer range queries repeatedly.
Choose items subject to a limited capacity.
Count numbers below a bound whose digits satisfy a rule.
Visit each node in a binary tree and combine child results.
Find the cheapest route through a graph with nonnegative edge weights.
